scope: isolated controlled replay; no production operations

historicalWindow.boundary: Historical numeric evidence contains no explicit rejection code or verified complete before/after frame snapshots.

reasonTaxonomy.surface_replace: Successful delta parse explicitly observed replaceOps > 0.
reasonTaxonomy.cross_window_reference: A validated replacement references seq below the resume base and cannot fold in this window.
reasonTaxonomy.partial_frame: Incomplete magic/skippable structure or UnexpectedEOF verified by fzstd across the whole compressed input.
reasonTaxonomy.invalid_offset: Negative/noninteger/out-of-range offset or no frame header at the expected delta boundary.
reasonTaxonomy.sequence_mismatch: Observed event seq differs from expected seq.
reasonTaxonomy.compatibility_reject: SessionCompatibilityError from an explicit schema/header/event/surface contract gate.
reasonTaxonomy.source_changed: Observed FileHandle/path fingerprint change or scan/publication fingerprint mismatch.
reasonTaxonomy.coverage_incomplete: Successful delta parse explicitly marks coverage.complete false.
reasonTaxonomy.worker_failure: Worker error, exit (including unexpected zero exit), postMessage failure, or parser task deadline.
reasonTaxonomy.unknown: Missing typed condition; raw error text is not used to infer a reason.

metrics.readBytes: Known FileHandle read returns, cumulatively including delta attempts, decoder fallback and full fallback.
metrics.decodedBytes: Observed decompressor output bytes including successful/native validation output; validationDecodedBytes is reported separately.
metrics.metricsExact: False after worker failure or cancellation without returned I/O stats; readBytes then is a measured lower bound.
metrics.currentBytes: Source size actually observed by the final successful parse, otherwise scan size; scannedBytes keeps the initial scan snapshot.
metrics.publication: complete means parser/publication check finished; commit means index.json atomic commit finished. published only becomes true after commit for accepted metadata.

retryBoundary: At most three automatic build rounds per unchanged source fingerprint. Each round retains up to two delta attempts and two necessary full attempts for explicitly partial input. A changed source fingerprint or an actual recovered FTS backend may reopen a bounded budget. This is not a claim of only three parser tasks.
continuationFindings: Preserved previous complete metadata and SQLite checkpoint/rows/anchors for explicitly partial or unstable append only; compatibility/unknown strict gates remain.
A post-failure fresh scan previously swallowed completion during the third rejected publication; baseline now uses the exact scan consumed by the builder.
Unchanged duplicate watcher events now reconcile fingerprints and cannot reset the same partial-source retry budget.
Actual FTS onRecovered is an external backend change and schedules a bounded same-source checkpoint reconciliation.
Ordinary status render now displays structured startup role/state/phase/completed/total/elapsedMs and safe error code; absent progress remains unknown (-).
